task: Author a project skill that mandates co-located unit tests for the logic layer, Storybook stories for common components and each main route, 100% unit-test coverage, and MSW as one shared API-mock layer for both tests and stories — then bring the repository into compliance with that standard.
acceptanceCriteria: A project-local skill defines the standard and is tracked by git (not swallowed by the .gitignore skill opt-in list)
Every hook, util, helper, Server Action and designated Route Handler in the coverage allowlist has a co-located unit test file
Unit-test coverage reaches 100% for statements, branches, functions and lines across the allowlist, and the threshold genuinely fails the process below that rather than only printing a number
UI components are exempt from unit tests, and that exemption is achieved structurally by the allowlist carrying no .tsx glob rather than by a maintained exclude list
Every common component, judged by a mechanically checkable content test, has a co-located Storybook story documenting its main variants
Each main route that renders presentational UI has one viewable Storybook story that needs no login, no dev server and no live Supabase instance
One shared MSW handler module serves both the vitest Node runtime and the Storybook browser runtime, with no duplicate handler for the same endpoint
The existing e2e suite still passes, and the extraction of TodoScreen from app/todo/page.tsx changes no markup, no className and does not weaken the authoritative auth guard
lint, format check, unit tests with coverage, build, typecheck and the Storybook build all exit 0
blastRadius: app/todo/page.tsx is the only production runtime file modified — its render block now delegates to TodoScreen while the authoritative getUser guard stays in place, so a mistake here would be an access-control or visual regression on the protected route
vitest.config.ts changes what the coverage number measures; widening the allowlist to include .tsx would silently make the 100% figure dishonest again
The CI quality job swapped pnpm test:unit for pnpm test:unit:coverage and gained a Build Storybook step, so a coverage shortfall or a broken story now turns CI red
public/mockServiceWorker.js is generated and served from public/, and is excluded from eslint because pnpm lint runs eslint bare over the repo
tsconfig.json gained .storybook globs; TypeScript's **/* patterns skip dot-directories, so without them type-aware lint cannot parse those files
No database, migration, API contract or user-facing product behavior changed
contracts: app/todo/page.tsx must keep the authoritative createClient -> getUser -> redirect('/login') guard before any render; this is the app's access boundary
components/todo/todo-screen.tsx must remain a non-async Server Component with no 'use client' directive, receiving all data through props
mocks/handlers.ts is the single source of MSW handlers for both runtimes; /auth/v1/authorize is intentionally absent because signInWithOAuth is a top-level browser navigation MSW cannot intercept
The coverage allowlist must never contain a .tsx glob
